about: Corrections to the KJV text in bible/, found by tools/text-review/compare.py (October 2026). Each verse here read differently from the Pure Cambridge Edition while at least one other independent electronic KJV agreed with the Pure Cambridge; our reading was shared by no source but Project Gutenberg #10, the transcription our text came from. 'was' is the old text and 'now' the corrected text; tools/apply-text-corrections.js applies them. Differences that are only Oxford and Cambridge spellings of the same 1769 text (enquire/inquire, counsellor/counseller, razor/rasor) are not here: see edition-differences.json.
